title: Propagate phase result
description: The typed record the propagate phase returns to the loop orchestrator in place of a prose summary. `obligations` and `uncovered_obligations` drive convergence; `generated_tests` is the tamper baseline the witness re-derives; `summary` carries the one human-readable line.

uncovered_obligations.description: one entry per uncovered obligation; must be empty for the loop to treat the spec as converged. Each carries a reason so nothing is silently dropped.

generated_tests.description: the tamper baseline the witness re-derives; one entry per generated test file

test_paths.description: test files generated or updated this run

summary.description: the `N obligations, M covered, K uncovered` line
